meta.name: comment-checker
meta.description: Use when Codex needs to understand or respond to automatic comment-checker feedback emitted after an edit-like PostToolUse hook.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 理解并回应代码审查的自动反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在编辑代码后处理自动审查反馈。
copy.tagline_en: Understand and respond to automatic code review feedback
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to handle automatic review feedback after editing code.

howto.what: 编辑类操作成功后,Claude 会收到 comment-checker 的自动注释检查反馈;若报告警告,该反馈会阻塞流程,Claude 需先修正或解释被标记的注释再继续。
howto.when: 当一次编辑类工具调用(如 apply_patch、write、edit 等)成功,且 comment-checker 报告警告时接管;非编辑类工具被该插件忽略。

say.text: 帮我看看 comment-checker 标记了哪个注释
say.note: Claude 指出被标记的注释位置

say.text: 把刚才被 comment-checker 警告的注释改掉
say.note: Claude 修正后再继续后续改动

say.text: 解释一下这段注释为什么被警告
say.note: Claude 给出说明而非直接修改

howto.what_en: After a successful apply_patch, write, or edit call, Claude gets automatic comment-checker feedback; if a warning is reported, that feedback is blocking, so Claude must fix or explain the flagged comment before continuing.
howto.when_en: Triggers when an edit-like tool call succeeds (apply_patch, write, edit, etc.) and comment-checker reports a warning. Non-edit tools are ignored by this plugin.

say_en.text: Show me which comment comment-checker flagged
say_en.note: Claude points out the flagged comment

say_en.text: Fix the comment comment-checker warned about
Explain why this comment got flagged
